midi_fields.label_midi: Label MIDI from MATLAB variable labelMIDI.
midi_fields.score_midi: Real-audio MIDI from MATLAB variable scoreMIDI.

boundary_rule: All exported note times are relative to startIdx. Note 1 starts at 0; each internal boundary is click_times[i] - startIdx/sample_rate; note 10 ends at (endIdx - startIdx)/sample_rate.
